heartbeat_ledger_note: heartbeat.jsonl belongs to the last window: the restart starts a new ledger instead of appending to the previous window's

windows.replaced_by_restart: the first window's LAB_RUN_REPORT.json was overwritten by --restart with the same run id; its cycles survive in logs/paper.log and heartbeat.jsonl

stop_report.note: a child that exits non-zero, or that has to be killed because it did not finalise, is a failure even though it was stopped on purpose (§2, §57)

LIVE.reason: no live path exists: every child is read-only market data or PAPER

INGEST.reason: read-only market data via the configured provider

SIGNALS.reason: projection of the persisted decision traces; independent of admission, so REJECTED/NO_ALPHA rows are produced with 0 admitted strategies

SHADOW.reason: SHADOW records an observation and can never create an order

PAPER_ORDER.reason: the admission ledger admits none of its 24 strategies for paper (gate not met)

ANALYST.reason: read-only sidecar; records NOT_CONFIGURED when no provider key is present

note: a 72 h window was not attempted in this session; the measured window is reported as measured. 24x7 is neither claimed nor certified
